panels.shot: Top-down. Elias and Nero go down broken tiled stairs into black. Rain falls through a street grate in a thin column of light. A torn 1950s poster: a smiling family on a metro car, LIGNE 0 - LA VILLE SOUS LA VILLE.

lines.text: Under Valmora there is a second city. It never sees rain. It only hears it.

panels.shot: Wide. A dead platform under a single green work lamp. A red rat with a crown is sprayed on the tiles. Black water covers the tracks, with an oil rainbow on it.

lines.text: The Tunnel Rats. Firebugs for hire. Bell's fire had a price, and they had a price list.

panels.shot: Close-up. Nero growls, ears flat, looking into a black tunnel mouth. Elias's hand rests on the dog's back.

lines.text: Elena's dog. He hears what I can't.

panels.shot: Medium. In the tunnel, a dozen eyes and lit cigarettes glow. A knife flies out of the dark toward the camera.
